scientific_integrity: The new result is the asymptotically sharp order of the unrestricted misclassification probability and exact class-symmetric error for a previously published voting-game family. The original family, its C-completeness, and its exact normalized weight-excess threshold are credited to the primary source. All new mathematical bounds are independently derived in RESULT.md and supported by check.py.
scientific_limitations: The unrestricted minimum is determined within a factor of 20, not exactly. Uniform random labeled coalitions and nonnegative weighted-majority rules are essential to the statement. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed prior work and independent checking.
title: Exponentially rare optimal voting misclassification in a three-class flip game
